newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends sharply down, cocoa rallies.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends sharply down, cocoa rallies.

text.p: COFFEE - Ends sharply down after fund selling drives heaviest sell-off in weeks. Sept $150 lower at $1,585.
COCOA - Posts modest rally on short covering after recent declines. Steadier sterling helps. Sept up 12 stg at 1,045 stg.
SUGAR - Mixed in pm as August/Oct spread widens ahead of August expiry. Oct down 40 cents at $316.50.
